items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: So Ed of course was not going to be available. So they come looking for me at the last minute to go in and play with the Tonight Show band

ctx.x: When I was with Tony Bennett we were scheduled to appear at a Friar’s Club Roast here in Los Angeles. And we were on with Doc Severinsen’s Tonight Show band so Eddie Shaughnessy, you know and all the cats and us. Well around four o’clock that afternoon,

tragically, Ed Shaughnessy’s younger son was killed in a car accident. So Ed of course was not going to be available. So they come looking for me at the last minute to go in and play with the Tonight Show band, which I was more than willing to do. But we couldn’t find Tony Bennett’s road manager. He had disappeared. And he had my cymbals and my stick bag. And Eddie, like any drummer would do, had his cymbals and his stick bag with him. So the only thing that was on the stage was Ed’s drumset, which is massive,…
I can just see, what happens when you’re playing a ballad? No Joe, brushes, we want brushes.
